Third-party libraries served locally so the page works without a CDN.

leaflet/   Leaflet 1.9.4 (BSD 2-Clause), https://leafletjs.com
           files: leaflet.js, leaflet.css, images/ (from dist/), LICENSE
chartjs/   Chart.js 4.4.1 (MIT), https://www.chartjs.org
           file: chart.umd.min.js (UMD build), LICENSE.md

Both come unchanged from the npm packages of the same version.
